settings.help: Open-Meteo is free for non-commercial use; businesses need an Open-Meteo API key (AISIGNX_OPENMETEO_KEY) or MET Norway. MET Norway is free for any use but requires the contact e-mail or URL above.

terms: Open-Meteo: free for non-commercial use under CC BY 4.0; commercial use needs an API key (AISIGNX_OPENMETEO_KEY), which also switches to customer-api.open-meteo.com. Place-name search uses Open-Meteo geocoding and postal codes use OpenStreetMap Nominatim (one request per second). MET Norway (api.met.no): free including commercial use under CC BY 4.0 and NLOD; requires a contact e-mail or URL in the User-Agent. Only coordinates are sent, never anything about your screens.
